name: Futanari Goddess 🕯️
source:
Complete dedication to the holy temple of the Goddess was important. The new acolyte promised herself she would do everything asked of her by the sexy head priestess. But how could she know what wicked things would be asked of her in the name of their Goddess when it was just them in the temple?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3748660/Futanari_Goddess/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
全身心奉献给女神的圣殿，这件事很重要。新来的侍祭向自己保证，性感的女祭司长提出任何要求，她都会照做。可她怎么会知道，等到圣殿里只剩两个人时，对方会以女神的名义，要她做出哪些下流的事？

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3748660/Futanari_Goddess/]Steam[/url]］
